issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.8.2 descendants(); FHIR R4 §2.9.1 FHIRPath primitive model
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-12 HISTORIAN probe: on a Patient with _birthDate.extension.valueString='midday', native descendants().count() returned ['12'] while forced Python fallback returned ['16']; native descendants().where($this = 'midday').count() returned ['0'] while fallback returned ['1']. §5.8 tree navigation is over child/descendant nodes and FHIR R4 §2.9.1 says FHIRPath abstracts away JSON/XML primitive split representation, so raw _birthDate JSON containers must not leak through descendants() when children() hides them.
issues.root_cause: Forced Python fallback descendants() used create_reduce_children(..., False), traversing underscore split-primitive JSON containers that children() deliberately hides.
issues.resolution: Changed fallback descendants() to recurse with the same child projection as children(), preserving native/fallback parity and preventing raw _birthDate-style split JSON descendants.
issues.verified_in: .temp/qa/fp12_historian_probe_after_fix.log; pytest test_tree_utility_parity.py (6 passed); native sqllogictest 528 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.9.1 trace(name : String [, projection])
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-12 HISTORIAN probe: native name.trace(id).given.count() returns ['0'] / [0], while forced Python fallback returns ['2'] / [2] on a Patient with id='p1' and two given names. The trace name argument is the ordinary String argument; §5.9.1 specifically gives only the optional projection special evaluation over the traced input while the function still returns input unchanged.
issues.root_cause: Native trace evaluated the String name argument with the traced source collection as focus; only the optional projection should use that traced input focus.
issues.resolution: Changed native trace dispatch to evaluate the name argument against outer_input for sourced calls, while preserving projection evaluation against the traced input.
issues.verified_in: .temp/qa/fp12_historian_probe_after_fix.log; pytest test_tree_utility_parity.py (6 passed); native sqllogictest 528 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822
